title: Roadmark electric-truck integration independent data audit
scope: Read-only application audit of 24 current exact truck configurations; no application changes. Manufacturer evidence packets and local source hashes audited; no fresh web or stock verification.

resolvedFindings.description: All seven Farizon charging durations originally used an hours-labelled destination key. Parent remapped minute-valued source facts to dc_charge_time_min with min units; SOC conditions preserved.
